description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved Plans) of permission 01116/11-13/P4 dated 09/11/2018 for the installation of an awning to rear of the public house, to allow for an alternative supporting structure and openable roof/cover over the rear seating area. The main changes include the creation of three supporting vertical poles (versus the two approved previously) and a reduction to the pitch of the roof.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of permission reference 01116/11-13/P5, namely 09/11/2021.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan [received 10 May 2019], Cover Letter [received 29 April 2019] and 2748 04 (Rev.C) [received 3 July 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
